title: Lift engineering: the two detachable quads at dusk (LE-a) and the leaning towers of the Rimrock Triple by day (LE-b)
notes: Block R3. Both parts: Photo Mode, ui hidden, icons hidden (Photo Mode setOverlayHidden plus the overlay op), capture mode (fps 30, capture 60), campath fps 60, sim speed 1 so the chairs move. Hold the start pose about 8 s before the take (auto exposure).

leA.notes: Fresh load of bridgetrailer1j, no time jump (normalized date about 0.54). From about 45 m above the two detachable bases, between the Summit Express (south line) and the Ridge Express (north line), looking east up both lines toward the horn. Take 1: a 67 m dolly along the lines with a 14 m rise, 24 mm; the near Summit Express towers (DQ16 and DQ18 at x 3206 and 3216) pass in the lower left, chairs on both lines, a groomer drives under the Summit Express in the first half, the horn gold at the top right. Take 2: 20 m higher and south of the Summit Express (weaker: the horn is cut and the chairs are small). Time of Day stills at 18.9, 19.1 and 19.3 (shoot/view/le-scout-tod.jpg): 19.3 is the warmest with a navy sky.

leB.notes: Tower lean on the Rimrock Triple (fixed-grip triple), the steepest stretch of the line: between tower nodes (2919, 895, -1818) and (2964, 965, -1891) the rope climbs 70 m over 85 m (about 39 degrees). Tower at (2919, -1818): SkiLiftTowerFG8HoldA, a hold-down tower, leaning 19.3 degrees from vertical. Tower at (2964, -1891): SkiLiftTowerFG12BreakA, a breakover tower, leaning 17.4 degrees. Lean = angle between the tower's up axis (Transform rotation) and world up, read with the entity op. For comparison on the same line: FG12 towers at (2871, -1742) 9.2 degrees and (3009, -1963) 8.9 degrees; FG16HoldA at (3099, -2107) 12.3 degrees; FG20BreakA at (3144, -2179) 10.4 degrees (the tallest, 20 m class). The camera is about 110 m off the line on its south-west side (the Silver Tram's ropes run about 145 m further out), at tower-top height, so the lean shows in the image plane. The frame edges are true vertical (roll 0). Take 1: Time of Day 12.5, moving 25 m up along the line and rising 17 m. Take 2: Time of Day 11, the same path reversed.
